description: Existing power plants and batteries in ERCOT from the EIA-860M monthly generator inventory, near a Texas address or coordinate or in a county: plant, operator, technology, nameplate MW, storage MWh and duration, first operating year, planned retirements, plus planned units EIA has on file. Filter by kind: storage, solar, wind, gas, coal, nuclear, hydro, other. Use when someone asks what is already built near a site, how much operating battery storage sits near a node or substation (saturation, versus the queue), battery durations in an area, or which gas or coal plants are nearby or retiring. Pair with battery_queue (what is coming) and volatile_nodes (spreads). Free accounts get location, kind and a size band; names, operators, exact MW and MWh, years and status are Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: Texas county name. Use this or a location.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 15, max 100.

status.description: operating (default), planned (EIA-reported planned units), or all.

name: power_plants
title: Operating and planned power plants (EIA-860M)
